research_question: Does source-backed dependency-graph context improve factual correctness on multi-hop C# architecture questions, compared with source-only retrieval using the same local model and context ceiling?

source.provenance_note: Local vendored checkout has no verified upstream Git revision; source hash freezes indexed source/project bytes.

questions.question: How is execution initialized and when does its main loop stop?

expected_facts.text: Execution is initialized by setting the root node, it requires current to be non-null.
in the while loop: while (current != null && (steps <= 0 || counter < steps))

questions.review_notes: Mentioning loop makes the LLM focus both answers on it, rather than look for the execution of the whole program

questions.question: How does Interpreter.Run initialize its random generator and grid before executing nodes?

expected_facts.text: It creates a Random instance using the seed argument.
It assigns grid = startgrid and clears the grid.
If origin is true, it sets the central grid cell to 1.

questions.question: What does Interpreter.Load call to create the grid, and how does it handle a null grid result?

expected_facts.text: Interpreter.Load calls Grid.Load with xelem and the MX, MY, MZ dimensions.
A null grid causes a failure message and a null return.

questions.question: What static call path connects Interpreter.Load to Node.Load?

expected_facts.text: Interpreter.Load calls Node.Factory.
Node.Factory calls result.Load, statically resolved to Node.Load.

questions.review_notes: Used in earlier development smoke tests; this is a calibration question, not held-out evidence. Runtime-override caveats are optional; an invented unique runtime implementation is a separate unsupported claim.

questions.question: Which method of Branch directly calls Node.Factory while constructing children?

expected_facts.text: Branch.Load calls the inherited static Factory method for each child, resolved to Node.Factory.

questions.question: How do SequenceNode and MarkovNode reach Node?

expected_facts.text: SequenceNode inherits Branch.
MarkovNode inherits Branch.
Branch inherits Node.

questions.question: What type-dependency cycle connects Node, Interpreter, and Branch?

expected_facts.text: Node has an ip field of type Interpreter.
Interpreter has a root field of type Branch.
Branch inherits Node, closing the type-dependency cycle.

questions.review_notes: The cycle needs three relationships, exceeding the graph context single-path depth of two; multiple supplied paths may be needed.

questions.question: Which database schema does MarkovJunior use to store execution state?
questions.review_notes: Used in earlier smoke tests; an abstention check, not a held-out generalization claim.

questions.question: How does OverlapNode reach Node?

expected_facts.text: OverlapNode inherits WFCNode.
WFCNode inherits Branch.
Branch inherits Node.

questions.review_notes: Needs three inheritance relationships, which exceeds the graph context single-path depth of two; multiple supplied paths may be needed. Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.

questions.question: Which classes inherit directly from RuleNode?

expected_facts.text: OneNode inherits RuleNode.
AllNode inherits RuleNode.
ParallelNode inherits RuleNode.

questions.review_notes: Reverse question: graph evidence currently follows outgoing relationships only, so answers may rely on source excerpts. Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.

questions.question: What static call path connects Program.Main to Grid.Load?

expected_facts.text: Program.Main calls Interpreter.Load.
Interpreter.Load calls Grid.Load.

questions.review_notes: Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.

questions.question: What static call path connects Interpreter.Run to Node.Go?

expected_facts.text: Interpreter.Run calls Branch.Go through current.Go().
Branch.Go calls Node.Go through node.Go() on each child node.

questions.review_notes: Static symbol resolution; runtime overrides such as RuleNode.Go are not required facts. Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.

questions.question: Which method calls Search.Run, and when?

expected_facts.text: RuleNode.Go calls Search.Run.
Search.Run is called only when observations is not null, futureComputed is false, ComputeFutureSetPresent returns true, and the search flag is enabled.

questions.review_notes: Reverse question: graph evidence currently follows outgoing relationships only. Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.

questions.question: Which class has a field whose type is the same class?

expected_facts.text: Branch has a field named parent of type Branch.

questions.review_notes: A self-loop field_use relationship. Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.

questions.question: Which node classes does Node.Factory create for a wfc element?

expected_facts.text: With a sample attribute it creates an OverlapNode.
With a tileset attribute it creates a TileNode.

questions.review_notes: Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.

questions.question: Which helper objects does RuleNode create while loading field and observe elements?

expected_facts.text: It creates a Field for each field element.
It creates an Observation for each observe element.

questions.review_notes: RuleNode stores them in array fields (Field[], Observation[]); array field types are not extracted, but the constructor_use relationships are. Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.

questions.question: How does Program.Main save each result?

expected_facts.text: For 2D results (FZ == 1) or when iso is set, it renders with Graphics.Render and saves a PNG with Graphics.SaveBitmap.
Otherwise it saves a VOX file with VoxHelper.SaveVox.

questions.review_notes: Added by Rosa Cortes on 2026-11-14; drafted with Claude and manually verified against the source; not used during development.
